hlg_3a28120d4c6451fa_001.rationale: llg_001 enables users to submit feedback or report issues via the app interface; llg_002 enables administrators to categorize and assign feedback to relevant teams; llg_003 enables administrators to respond to feedback with status updates — together, these form a complete user-to-administrator feedback loop with submission, assignment, and acknowledgment phases.
hlg_3a28120d4c6451fa_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to submit site-specific issues or feedback, and enable administrators to categorize, assign, and respond to those submissions with status updates.

hlg_7a8f3b0c33b97d2e_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to configure encryption and access controls for user data; llg_002 adds the capability to audit access and modification logs for compliance and anomaly detection; llg_003 adds the capability to enforce role-based access control for administrative functions, restricting sensitive operations. Together, these form a complete scope of user data security management, including configuration, monitoring, and enforcement, with no inferred or omitted functionality.
hlg_7a8f3b0c33b97d2e_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Configure, audit, and enforce user data security through encryption, access controls, and role-based permissions to ensure regulatory compliance and detect unauthorized activity.

Audit user data access and modification logs
Enforce role-based access control for administrative functions

hlg_a0c7e03bc4bc52e6_001.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to search for recycling facilities by location using GPS or manual address input. No other LLGs are provided, so the reconstructed goal encompasses only this single capability.
hlg_a0c7e03bc4bc52e6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to locate nearby recycling facilities using GPS or manual address input.

hlg_d834c838712b4c4c_001.rationale: llg_001 contributes the capability to view facility details such as operational hours and contact info, which is the only functional requirement provided. No other LLGs are supplied, so the reconstructed goal must reflect this single, specific capability without inference or generalization.
hlg_d834c838712b4c4c_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable users to access detailed operational information about facilities including hours of operation, contact details, and website links.

hlg_e805346d2be00aaa_001.rationale: llg_001 enables administrators to review and approve/reject facility data submitted by users or representatives; llg_002 enables administrators to update facility operational status or contact details. These are distinct but complementary capabilities, both involving administrative actions on facility-related information, with no broader or unrelated capability introduced.
hlg_e805346d2be00aaa_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable administrators to review submitted facility data and update facility operational status or contact details.

hlg_f6ffc344401c4271_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initiation of secure communication from administrators to facility representatives, establishing the outbound capability. llg_002 enables the reception and response from facility representatives, establishing the inbound capability. Together, they define a complete, bidirectional communication channel focused on operational resolution and updates, with no unrelated or broader capabilities introduced.
hlg_f6ffc344401c4271_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Establish and maintain secure, bidirectional communication between administrators and facility representatives to resolve operational issues and exchange updates.
